messages.text:
I’ve added the Start/Vite/test scaffolding and will keep the local database under the workspace so the app can bootstrap from source-controlled seed data.

Next I’m adding the typed schema, SQL calculations, API/server contracts, and route components that expose those calculations to the storefront, cart, detail, and analytics screens.
